fields.summary: Change set 01M61GW7K1PDG7HMFXMN3YNA7B (Build and review render) intends that plain build and review runs leave their branch rendered: each renders and commits .rhiza/rendered and the uncommitted .rhiza/log entries before it ends, so rhiza check passes on the branch without a hand-made render commit. It serves milestone-4's done point m4-runs-hold-up. The run had no owner (autonomous), so nothing was asked of anyone and no owner words exist. The plan follows the ship-change workflow, which already renders and commits after build and after review. Decided by assumption: the render lives in the build and review workflow files, not in the run engine, and it is the last step of each. Open: whether build renders after a failed build too.
fields.title: Build and review render, planned autonomously
